signIn.title: Sign in
signIn.failed: Sign-in didn’t work. Please try again.
signIn.noProviders: This server has no sign-in options set up.

welcome.title: Welcome to Dulo
welcome.intro: This short setup creates your family tree on this server and makes you its administrator. It takes a few minutes, and you can change everything later.
welcome.token: You’ll need the setup token. The server prints it in its log on every start until the setup is done, in a line like this one (or it’s the value of dulo.setup.token in the server configuration):

token.title: Enter the setup token
token.label: Setup token
token.hint: Copy it from the server log.
token.invalid: That’s not the setup token. Check the server log and try again.

signIn.title: Sign in
signIn.intro: Sign in with the account you’ll use for Dulo. This account becomes the tree’s administrator, with full access.

name.title: Name your tree
name.label: Tree name
name.hint: For example “The Smith family”. You can change it later.
name.required: Enter a name of up to 200 characters.

description.title: Describe your tree
description.label: Description (optional)
description.hint: A few words about the tree, for the people you invite.

features.title: Choose the features
features.intro: Turn on what your family needs. You can change this later.

access.title: Who gets access

registration.title: New accounts
registration.auto: People who sign in get an account right away, with the roles below.
registration.approval: People who sign in wait until an administrator approves them.

access.noRoles: No roles from this provider; an administrator assigns them.
access.later: You can edit the roles later, in the administration.

review.title: Check and finish
review.signInAgain: Your sign-in has expired. Sign in again, then finish the setup.

registration.auto: New accounts are active right away.
registration.approval: New accounts wait for an administrator’s approval.

result.title: Result
result.intro: For the technically curious: everything this Dulo will start with. That’s the server configuration plus your choices from this setup.
result.order: Each value ends with where it comes from. A later source overrides an earlier one, which is then struck through:

done.title: {name} is ready
done.text: You’re its administrator. Invite your family next: they sign in with their own accounts.

problem.unknown: Something went wrong. Please try again.
problem.network: Can’t reach the Dulo server. Check your connection and try again.
problem.account-pending: Your account is waiting for an administrator’s approval.
problem.concurrent-modification: Someone else changed this in the meantime. Reload to see their changes.
problem.forbidden: You don’t have permission to do this.
problem.has-links: This is still linked to other records.
problem.not-found: This doesn’t exist, or no longer exists.
problem.precondition-required: This change is missing its version. Reload and try again.
problem.restore-conflict: This version can’t be restored because it conflicts with the current data.
problem.role-exists: A role with this key already exists.
problem.role-in-use: This role is still in use.
problem.tree-not-initialized: The family tree hasn’t been created yet.

people.name: People
people.description: The people in the tree, with their names and details.

events.name: Events
events.description: Births, marriages, deaths and other events.

map-view.name: Map
map-view.description: Places and events on a map.

timeline.name: Timeline
timeline.description: Events in the order they happened.

audit-log.name: Change history
audit-log.description: Who changed what and when, with undo.
